query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WITH DISTINCT cr, meeting
RETURN cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,
       meeting.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,
       CASE WHEN toLower(meeting.canonicalMeetingNumber) ENDS WITH 'bis' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS meetingBisOrdinal,
       cr.crNumber AS crNumber
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, meetingBisOrdinal DESC, crNumber ASC, tdocNumber ASC
